imports.name: magpie-native-ai-pages
imports.scope: Native MyGo provider preferences, account settings and local gateway administration. Only the five retained AI service pages are available. Gateway keys, recording and call details remain owned by the local gateway. Gateway administration is compiled independently of the upstream desktop GUI and exposes no retired application routes.

imports.name: fluent-ui-motion
imports.scope: Fluent UI durationNormal (200ms) and curveDecelerateMin (0.33,0,0.1,1) are WinOne's standard restrained functional motion. Original token sources are retained; MyGo performs interruption and ReduceMotion. No Fluent fonts, icons, assets or runtime dependencies imported.

imports.name: mygo-winone-shell-file-drop
imports.scope: Windows Shell cross-integrity file-drop receiver adapted from WinOne's component_file_drop.rs. Native UI, OLE, hit testing and file dispatch stay upstream. Markdown tables wrap within the reading column. Opaque Windows native surfaces paint the complete interactive scene with the existing CPU renderer while D3D11 initializes asynchronously, preserving input and UI state on GPU handoff. Prepared from the verified pinned module into a repository source cache; never modifies the Go module cache.

imports.name: open-claude-ui
imports.scope: CDS 2.0 timing/easing, component radius hierarchy and compositor-only reveal/skeleton patterns adapted to existing WinOne settings and native menu primitives. No proprietary fonts, branding, audio, chat, cloud features or external runtime imported.

imports.name: windows-capture-recording
imports.scope: windows-capture 2.0.1 WGC runtime; MediaStreamSource event/deferral and profile setup adapted with a bounded queue, pooled IBuffer ownership, real VFR duration, pause clock and safe file publication.

imports.name: gifski-recording
imports.scope: Statically linked gifski 1.34.0 library only, default CLI/PNG/FFmpeg features disabled. Vendored from the exact release with additive buffer-recycle and final-PTS APIs; see third_party/gifski/WINONE.md. Full transitive notices in recording-notices.json. Combined distribution must comply with GPLv3/AGPLv3 section 13 and provide corresponding source; root WinOne license is not rewritten.

imports.name: magpie-curl-import
imports.scope: Pure curlOf/respellURL functions and ten provider examples reused for paste import. Commands are parsed as text, never executed. WinOne keeps its own form, drafts and credential store.

imports.name: croc-interconnect
imports.scope: Direct reuse of croc v11.5.5 transfer, store client, encryption and original tests. WinOne adapts progress, input prompts and process lifecycle only.

imports.name: fileshare-interconnect
imports.scope: Direct reuse of Rust HTTP engine, upstream tests and browser assets. WinOne adapts management, explicit paths, authentication and awaited shutdown; no transfer engine rewrite.

imports.name: tailcat-interconnect
imports.scope: Official v0.7.0 library dependency; forward listener lifecycle adapted from cmd/tailcat/forward.go. WinOne adds process control and a standard HTTP gateway to the existing FileShare service.

imports.name: edge-speech-gec-v2
imports.scope: Go Sec-MS-GEC v2 protocol implementation derived from rany2/edge-tts 7.3.1 drm.py. Modified package/token names and removed standalone clock functions to retain WinOne cancellation, clock-skew correction and transport. Full corresponding modified source is apps/result-ui/edge_gec.go and is rebuilt by build/build-results.ps1; WinOne is GPL-3.0. No Python or external TTS runtime is bundled.

imports.name: cindy-shared-motion
imports.scope: Standalone collapse animation and reduced-motion preference used by the retained provider avatar picker. No Chat adapter or registry is loaded.

imports.name: cindy-shared-fonts
imports.scope: Shared font loading, fallbacks and HarmonyOS language-selector patch. The retained desktop settings use these fonts independently of Chat. Font package licenses remain in the frontend dependency inventory.
